canary.stop_reason: Case 1 added an undeclared days field after its internal validator had accepted the draft; the fixed baseline-passing case therefore failed the output contract.

case_results.summary: The Workflow used seven Agent Steps. Its draft passed validate_travel_plan, but the final repair/pass-through Agent added a days key to day 1, causing the runner output contract to fail. No direct Tool executor was authored.
The runner had begun outer authoring calls for case 48 before case 1 was audited. It was interrupted before a Workflow source or answer was produced.

tokens.candidate_observation_caveat: The full-chain totals include partial case-48 authoring and omit one request cancelled after the quality gate failed, so they are not a complete case-1 comparison.

notes: The runtime capability itself passed strict-JSON, preflight, registry filtering, timing, and zero-token sidecar tests.

The live author did not receive the detailed Direct Tool syntax because its whole-file Skill read was truncated to the first 20,000 bytes; only the short frontmatter description was visible before authoring.
No evaluator or remaining canary cases were run after the non-retryable fixed-case quality failure.

A later candidate may reintroduce the runtime only together with a concise Direct Tool authoring contract before the Skill read truncation boundary; it must use a new commit and a new result directory.
